meta.method: 28 fresh LLM sessions via gateway RPC; every present_card tool/call paired with its tool/result (isError via top-level error key); server resolver replayed locally (applyDeterministicWidgets via tsx src import); raw evidence: vfy-w22r1-bg-repeatA|s1|s2|s2r|s3|s3r.json + restat.json + vfy-w22r1-uj-journey.json|log
meta.caveat: widget rewrite is computed inside execute() but its output has no downstream (not logged, not pushed, client renders tool/call arguments) — final-payload statistics therefore equal the model-declared payload on the wire
